inputs.name: atomicComponents.options
inputs.description: This optional object configures resolution of imported native atoms; only its `aliases` property is read, as import-prefix-to-directory mappings. Relative imports resolve from the component filename, while aliases match only specifiers beginning with the configured prefix followed by `/`; a missing or nullish `aliases` value behaves as `{}`.

outputs.name: atomicComponents
outputs.description: The factory returns a Svelte markup preprocessor object named `harness-atomic-components`; its callback inlines recognized native atoms before Svelte validation and returns transformed code, a source map, and dependency paths. The callback returns `undefined` when there is no filename or the content contains neither `/atoms/` nor `<hx-`.

errors.name: Invalid atomic markup or native atom configuration
errors.description: Markup processing throws `Error` for unknown native atoms, missing `@harness-atoms` directory declarations, unresolved non-relative native atom imports, or atom sources that fail the element-contract check. Parsing and filesystem errors encountered while examining component or atom files can also propagate.
